name: Start Agent
description: Lists the Session's Agents from the Server's catalog, recent and installed first, filters them as the person types, and starts the chosen one in a new Tab, a split, or a new Worktree.

states: See the first lookup run: only the Agents already found show under Recent and Installed, with no fold row and the status line saying the lookup runs.
Inspect Recent, the rest of Installed A to Z, and one row that counts the Agents not found; Enter on it unfolds them.
Move the highlight with Up and Down, change Opens in, and see Start follow the highlighted Agent.
Inspect the same groups, fold row, places and footer in Simplified Chinese.
See every Agent stay startable under Not checked on this machine, the ones known missing under Not found, and the warning that the lookup could not check.
See a query no Agent matches empty the list, disable Start, and say so in the status line.

useWhen: A person starts one of the Session's Agents in a new terminal of the Workbench.
avoidWhen: The person goes to an Agent session that already runs; use the Agent Board.
The person runs any action by name; use the Unified Search Surface.
invariants: The dialog follows the Server's catalog stream without polling, asks for a new lookup when it opens, and keeps the last catalog when the stream fails.
Rows follow the shared Start Agent rows rule: Recent, then Installed A to Z, then one fold row for the Agents not found, or Not checked and Not found when no lookup gave a result.

The search field holds the keyboard: typing filters by name, command or id, Up and Down move the highlight, Enter starts the highlighted Agent or unfolds, and a key held with Ctrl, Alt, or Meta passes through.
Escape clears a query first and closes only an empty field's dialog; Escape, Cancel, the close button, and backdrop dismissal return focus to where it was when the dialog opened.
One status line keeps its height and says, highest first, that this platform cannot start an Agent, that the lookup runs or could not check, or that no Agent matches.

Opens in lists only the places a start can use now, New Tab first; starting closes the dialog, and New Worktree… then opens the New Worktree form in its place with a branch proposed for the Agent, the Agent starting only once that form is submitted.
